name: Postcode Context
description: Comprehensive Great Britain Postcode & Outcode Intelligence API covering England, Scotland, and Wales. Returns ONS Census 2021 demographics, Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD) deciles, HM Land Registry property sales and GBP/sqm estimates, LSOA/MSOA geographic codes, Ofcom broadband connectivity, and AI-ready socio-economic affluence scoring.

endpoints.description: GET /api/v1/postcode/{postcode} - Get Great Britain Postcode Intelligence Profile

postcode.description: Great Britain postcode (e.g. SW1A 1AA, BB7 3BB, EH1 1YZ, CF10 1EP). Accepts spaces, no spaces (SW1A1AA), or URL-encoded (+ / %20). Northern Ireland (BT) postcodes excluded.

view.description: Slice target view: full (complete dataset, default), brief (or summary/ai, ~80 tokens brief), property (valuations & EPC), demographics (Census & IMD deciles), education (nearest schools & proximity), healthcare (nearest GP surgery), transit (rail & metro), or services (education, healthcare, transit & digital connectivity)

exclude.description: Comma-separated domains to exclude from payload: schools, healthcare, transit (e.g. exclude=schools,healthcare,transit)

format.description: Export format: json (default), flat, csv, or markdown/md (GitHub Flavored Markdown)

endpoints.description: GET /api/v1/postcode?postcode=... - Single Postcode Socio-Economic Profile (query string alternative)

postcode.description: Valid Great Britain unit postcode (e.g. SW1A 1AA or SW1A1AA)

view.description: Slice target view for returned postcode profiles: full (complete dataset, default), brief (or summary/ai, ~80 tokens brief), property, demographics, education, healthcare, transit, or services

format.description: Export format: json (default), csv, or markdown/md (GitHub Flavored Markdown)

postcodes.description: List of 2 to 5 Great Britain postcodes to compare (England, Scotland, Wales)

endpoints.description: GET /api/v1/compare?postcodes=... - Compare 2 to 5 Postcodes (comma-separated query string alternative)

postcodes.description: Comma-separated list of 2 to 5 unit postcodes to compare

endpoints.description: POST /api/v1/batch - Batch Enrich Great Britain Postcodes (Defaults to view="brief"; pass view="full" for all 113 metrics)

view.description: Slice target view across batch results: brief (~80 tokens brief summary, default to preserve context window budget), full (complete dataset per postcode), property, demographics, education, healthcare, transit, or services.

format.description: Export format: json (default), flat, csv, or markdown/md (GitHub Flavored Markdown)

postcodes.description: List of 1 to 50 Great Britain postcodes to enrich

endpoints.description: GET /api/v1/batch?postcodes=... - Bulk Postcode Enrichment (comma-separated query string alternative) (Defaults to view="brief"; pass view="full" for all 113 metrics)

postcodes.description: Comma-separated list of 1 to 50 unit postcodes

endpoints.description: GET /api/v1/outcode/{outcode} - Get Great Britain Outward Code District Summary

outcode.description: Great Britain outward postal district code (e.g. BB7, SW1A, EH1, CF10)

view.description: Slice target view: full (complete dataset, default), brief (or summary/ai, ~80 tokens brief), property, demographics, education, healthcare, transit, or services

exclude.description: Comma-separated domains to exclude from payload: schools, healthcare (e.g. exclude=schools,healthcare)

format.description: Export format: json (default), flat, csv, or markdown/md (GitHub Flavored Markdown)

endpoints.description: GET /api/v1/outcode?outcode=... - Outward Postal District Summary (query string alternative)

outcode.description: Valid outward code (e.g. SW1A, BB7, M1, EH1)
